blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. It covers realistic scenarios such as agent state tracking, tool and skill selection, preference judgments, and rubric scoring, with option spaces ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs extending to 64,817 tokens. With MMDM, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of 28 decision models, showing that many perform well on common knowledge yet struggle with interdependent options, constrained decisions, and multi-select tasks. For example, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 reaches 78.75% Hard Single-select Accuracy on world knowledge, but only 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning, while the best Hard Multi-select Accuracy across all models is 36.81%. These results highlight joint reasoning, constraint-aware selection, and complete multi-select recovery as key priorities for decision model development, with MMDM providing a testbed for measuring this progress.
blocks.zh: 系统1决定 模型直接在单个前传的状态下,对特定查询选项作出结构化概率决定,而不自动生成推理轨迹或文字回放. 最近的评价涉及各种任务,但往往依靠现有的基准,因为事先接触试验材料可能掩盖一般情况。 此外,现实世界的决策往往涉及较长的背景、很大的选择空间和复杂的逻辑依赖性,而现有的基准却无法充分抓住这些挑战。 因此,我们引入了MMDM(Massive Multiple Taking),这是跨16个任务类别5,448个高质量问题的基准,将新构建的任务与源头重构和重写结合起来,用于在新情况下进行单选,多选和软标签决策. 它涵盖现实情景,如代理状态跟踪、工具和技能选择、偏好判断和标分,选项空间从2到1 024,投入扩展至64 817个令牌。 与MMDM一起,我们对28个决策模式进行了全面的定量评价,表明许多决策模式在共同知识方面表现良好,但与相互依存的选择、受制约的决定和多选择的任务相抗衡。 例如,Perplexity Confer-V1.2在世界知识上达到了78.75%的硬性单选精确度,但在选项逻辑上只有53.95%,在约束性规划上只有47.95%,而在所有模型中最好的硬性多选精确度是36.81%. 这些结果突出了联合推理、制约意识选择和完整的多选择恢复是决策模式开发的关键优先事项,MMDM为衡量这一进展提供了一个测试床。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
System-1 Decision Models make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a textual state in a single forward pass ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; Microsoft, 2026 ) , which support diverse applications, including text and intent classification, model and tool selection, and rubric-based quality scoring ( Ling et al., 2026 ) .
Therefore, a rigorous and comprehensive evaluation of these models must account for the diversity and complexities of decision making in real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh:
系统1决定 模型对特定查询选项作出结构化概率决定,在单一前传中具有文本状态(TypeSafe AI, 2026;Microsoft, 2026.),这些选项支持多种应用,包括文本和意向分类,模型和工具选择,以及基于路由的质量评分(Ling等, 2026.).
因此,对这些模式进行严格而全面的评价,必须考虑到现实世界中决策的多样性和复杂性。

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks have assessed decision models across diverse tasks and calibration criteria ( Duan et al., 2026 ; Solka, 2026 ; Standhartinger, 2026 ) . However, many existing evaluations draw heavily on widely circulated public benchmarks, making test-set contamination a central concern for benchmark validity ( Oren et al., 2024 ) . Moreover, real-world decisions often combine long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies. For example, a practically useful model needs to track the current agent state, determine whether an earlier approval remains valid, and select an eligible tool from a large catalog with heterogeneous prerequisites. These settings call for an evaluation that combines task breadth with new instances and explicit tests of these capabilities.
blocks.zh: 最近的基准评估了不同任务中的决策模型和校准标准(Duan等人,2026;Solka,2026;Standhartinger,2026)。 然而,许多现有评价大量借鉴了广为传播的公共基准,使测试定点污染成为基准有效性的核心关切(Oren等人,2024年)。 此外,现实世界的决定往往结合了长的背景、大的选择空间和复杂的逻辑依赖。 例如,一个实际有用的模型需要跟踪目前的代理状态,确定先前的批准是否仍然有效,并从一个具有不同先决条件的大目录中选择一个合格的工具。 这些设置要求评价将任务宽度与新的实例结合起来,并明确测试这些能力。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 questions for evaluating text-based System-1 Decision Models across realistic decision scenarios. It combines broad task coverage with explicit tests of context understanding, option discrimination, and logical consistency. Table 1 compares its scope with existing decision benchmarks.

blocks.en:
Specifically, MMDM evaluates Hard Single-select , Hard Multi-select , and Soft-label questions, requiring a unique correct choice, the complete valid set, or a prediction matching the reference distribution over outcomes. These answer types capture practical requirements such as choosing the next actions, identifying all eligible tools, and assigning probabilities to rubric scores under uncertainty. Decisions can depend on agent states, action prerequisites, or relationships among options. In benchmark construction, source answers and contextual evidence ground rewrites of states, queries and distractors to reduce memorization-induced score inflation ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) .
We combine these adaptations with recompositions and newly constructed tasks. The resulting 16 categories span knowledge and comprehension, logic and constraints, agent and workflow decisions, and preference and rubric judgments. With 2–1,024 options and complete inputs of up to 64,817 tokens, MMDM also tests these capabilities across varied context lengths and option spaces.
blocks.zh:
具体而言,MMDM评价 硬单选(Hard-Single-select ),硬多选(Hard-Multi-select),和软标签问题(Soft-label),需要独特的正确选择,完整的有效集,或者对结果的参考分布进行相匹配的预测. 这些答案类型捕捉到实际要求,例如选择下个动作,确定所有符合条件的工具,以及分配概率来标出不确定的分数. 决定可能取决于代理状态、行动先决条件或备选办法之间的关系。 在基准构建中,源答案和背景证据对状态,询问和分心器进行地重写,以降低因记忆引起的得分通胀(Zhu等,2024;Zhao等,2025.).
我们把这些适应与重新组合和新建的任务结合起来。 由此产生的16个类别涵盖知识和理解、逻辑和制约、代理和工作流程决定以及偏好和标题判断。 MMDM拥有2–1,024个选项和最多64,817个令牌的完整输入,MMDM还在不同的上下文长度和选项空间中测试这些能力.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , our evaluation of 28 decision models reveals substantial differences across capabilities. Models that perform well on world knowledge still struggle with interdependent options, decisions subject to constraints, and complete multi-select recovery. These capabilities matter in agent workflows, where choices interact, actions have prerequisites, and several tools or skills may be valid for the current goal. Specifically, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 ( Perplexity AI, 2026 ) achieves 78.75% Hard Single-select accuracy on world knowledge, compared with 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning. WeMM-JEV 27B ( WeMM-JEV Team, 2026 ) achieves the highest Hard Single-select accuracy of 76.00%, while the highest Hard Multi-select accuracy is 36.81%, highlighting the challenge of recovering all valid options. Model rankings also differ between hard-answer accuracy and soft-distribution error, making both necessary to characterize decision quality.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们对28个决策模式的评价显示,不同能力之间有很大差异。 在世界知识方面表现良好的模式仍然与相互依存的选择、受限制的决定以及完整的多选择恢复相抗衡。 这些能力在代理工作流程中很重要,在代理工作流程中,选择相互影响,行动具有先决条件,几种工具或技能对当前目标可能有效. 具体来说,Perplexity Concerners-V1.2(Perplexity AI, 2026年)在世界知识上实现了78.75%的硬单选精度,而选择逻辑上达到了53.95%,约束规划上达到了47.95%. WeMM-JEV 27B (WemM-JEV Team, 2026) 实现最高的硬单选精度为76.00%,而最高的硬多选精度为36.81%,凸显出回收所有有效选项的挑战. 模型排名在硬回答精度和软分配出错之间也存在差异,因此两者都有必要对决策质量进行定性.

blocks.en: Overall, our contributions are threefold. First, we introduce a multitask decision benchmark that combines fresh decision instances with long contexts, large option spaces, and interdependent options. Second, we provide a unified evaluation protocol for single-select correctness, multi-select completeness, and soft-label distributional fidelity, together with an open dataset and toolkit. Third, our evaluation reveals capability gaps that are not captured by previous decision-model benchmarks, including failures in joint consistency and complete multi-select recovery, providing concrete directions for future model development.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的贡献有三重。 首先,我们采用了一个多任务决策基准,将新的决策实例与长期背景、大选项空间和相互依存选项结合起来。 第二,我们为单一选择的正确性、多选择的完整性和软标签分配忠诚性提供统一的评价协议,以及开放数据集和工具包。 第三,我们的评价揭示了以往决策模式基准没有反映的能力差距,包括联合一致性和全面恢复多选择的失败,为今后的模式发展提供了具体方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
System-1 Decision Models produce structured probabilities over request-defined options in a single inference step.
Jev introduces a typed decision interface and Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions, making probability quality a central training objective ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) .
After this closed-source model, open implementations explore different ways to obtain these decisions from language-model backbones. SemIf reads logits for option tokens directly and supports shared-prefix reuse across queries ( Lee, 2026 ) . OpenJev learns a shared decision head over request-defined options, using supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning ( Shen, 2026 ) . Intern-Decision and H2O-Lightning extend typed decisions to multimodal inputs ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; H2O.ai, 2026 ) . Microsoft Decision-1 post-trains Qwen3.5-9B for single-pass scoring in routing, verification, and workflow control ( Microsoft, 2026 ) .
Together, these approaches develop efficient readout, task adaptation, and probability calibration. Their growing use in software and agent pipelines makes it essential to evaluate whether they preserve decision quality when the relevant evidence, prerequisites, and options interact.
blocks.zh:
系统1决定 模型在单一推论步骤中产生结构化概率,而不是请求确定的选项.
Jev引入了打入式决策界面和为校准决定而强化学习,使概率质量成为中心培训目标(TypeSafe AI,2026.).
在此封闭源代码模式后,开放实施探索从语言模型主干线获取这些决定的不同方式. SemIf 直接读取选项符号的日志,并支持共享前缀重复使用跨查询(Lee, 2026) . OpenJev在请求定义选项上学习共享决策头,使用监督学习后再进行强化学习(Shen, 2026). 实习决定和H2O-Lightning将打出的决定扩展至多式输入(Zhu等,2026;H2O.ai,2026.). 微软决定-1后出行Qwen3.5-9B,用于路由,校验,和工作流程控制方面的单通分(微软,2026).
这些方法共同发展了高效的读取、任务调整和概率校准。 它们越来越多地用于软件和代理管道,因此,在相关证据、先决条件和备选办法相互作用时,必须评估它们是否保持决策质量。

blocks.en:
JevBench establishes an early comparison of typed decision quality, calibration, latency, and cost ( Standhartinger, 2026 ) . DecisionBench broadens applied coverage to 43 tasks with runtime-defined options ( Solka, 2026 ) , while ReflexBench separated raw model quality from workflow-policy effects ( Navarro, 2026 ) . DecideBench subsequently introduced 400 contrastive decisions to test sensitivity to answer-changing context ( Yong, 2026 ) . Jev Evaluation examined 37 existing datasets with frozen templates ( Deußer et al., 2026 ) , and JEVal expanded systematic evaluation across 36 datasets and ten domains ( Duan et al., 2026 ) .
These tool kits improve coverage and comparability, but their main evaluations leave complete multi-select decisions underexplored. Additionally, broad source reuse also leaves a need for fresh decision instances Oren et al. (2024) .
Complementary resources target individual capabilities. AgentBench evaluates interactive agents ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . ToolBench evaluates tool-use tasks ( Qin et al., 2024 ) . LongBench and LongBench v2 studies long-context understanding in challenging realistic tasks ( Bai et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . MuSiQue evaluates multi-hop evidence composition ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) . They provide valuable capability tests, while a common assessment of option selection and probability allocation across these settings remains necessary.
MMDM addresses this gap by combining fresh decision scenarios, long inputs, and large option spaces with single-select, multi-select, and soft-label objectives.
blocks.zh:
Jev Bench建立了对打出的决定质量,校正,耐久,成本的早期比较(Standhartinger,2026.). Frex Bench将原始模型质量从工作流程政策效应(Navarro, 2026)中分离出来。 Federation Bench随后提出了400个对比性决定,以测试对变化的上下文的敏感性(Yong, 2026). Jev评价审查了37个带有冷冻模板的现有数据集(Deußer等,2026年),JEVal扩大了对36个数据集和10个领域的系统评价(Duan等,2026年)。
这些工具箱提高了覆盖面和可比性,但其主要评价没有充分利用完整的多选择决定。 此外,广泛的源再利用也使得需要新的决策实例 奥伦等 (2024).
补充资源的目标是个人能力。 Bench探员评价互动代理(Liu等,2024. Tool Bench评价工具使用任务(秦等,2024. Long Bench和Long Bench v2研究了在挑战现实任务方面的长文理解(Bai等,2024;Bai等,2025.). MuSiQue评价多跳证据构成(Trivedi等,2022年) . 它们提供了宝贵的能力测试,同时仍然有必要对选择选项和在这些环境中的概率分配进行共同评估。
MMDM通过将新的决策设想、长的投入和大选项空间与单选、多选取和软标签目标相结合来解决这一差距。

blocks.zh: 3 MMDM基准

blocks.en: MMDM evaluates decision capabilities across diverse tasks through a shared state–query–options interface. First, we formalize the decision problems, answer types and evaluation objectives (Section 3.1 ). Then, we describe data collection and construction (Section 3.2 ). Finally, we present task coverage and dataset statistics (Section 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Collection and Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据收集和建设

blocks.en: Collection. We select public datasets and agent trajectories that support a concrete decision with explicit options and a checkable answer. Sources span knowledge, reading, reasoning, preferences, code, and agent interactions. For example, QuALITY ( Pang et al., 2022 ) and LongBench v2 ( Bai et al., 2025 ) supply document-grounded questions, BIRD ( Li et al., 2023 ) supplies database problems, and ComplexFuncBench ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) and ToolTalk ( Farn and Shin, 2023 ) supply interaction histories. Source questions and annotations provide the basis for adaptation and verification.
blocks.zh: 藏经. 我们选择公共数据集和代理轨迹,支持具体的决定,有明确的选择和可核查的答案。 来源跨越了知识,阅读,推理,偏好,代码,以及代理交互. 例如,QuALITY(Pang等,2022年)和Long Bench v2(Bai等,2025年)提供文件依据的问题,BIRD(Li等,2023年)提供数据库问题,ComplexFunc Bench(Zhong等,2025年)和Toltalk(Farn和Shin,2023年)提供互动历史. 源问题和说明为调整和核实提供了依据。

blocks.en: Construction. We combine source-grounded adaptation with semantic recomposition and newly constructed tasks. For rewritten source instances, we retain the original answers and supporting evidence while reformulating the state, query, and distractors. Semantic and option-quality checks select the resulting instances. This strategy builds on evidence that benchmark rewriting can mitigate memorization-induced score inflation ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Recompositions introduce decision questions grounded in source databases or agent histories. Executable mechanisms construct interacting options, constrained plans, state transitions, and rubric outcomes with computable answers. Across all three routes, distractors are designed around identifiable failure modes, such as applying an expired rule, confusing entities, or overlooking the prerequisite.
blocks.zh: 建筑业. 我们把基于源的适应与语义分解和新建的任务结合起来. 对于重写源例,我们保留原始答案和辅助证据,同时重塑状态,查询和分心器. 语义和选项质量检查选择由此产生的实例。 该战略基于以下证据:基准重写可以减轻因记忆而引发的得分通货膨胀(Zhu等,2024;Zhao等,2025)。 重组引入基于源数据库或代理历史的决策问题。 可执行机制构建交互选项,受限计划,状态过渡,以及带有可计算答案的标点结果. 在所有三条路线上,分心器都是围绕着可识别的故障模式来设计的,比如应用已过期的规则,混淆的实体,或者俯瞰先决条件.

blocks.en: Validation and Selection. We verify answers using source evidence, executable checks, and model review appropriate to each construction route. Five-model majority screening is followed by independent human expert review of borderline cases. Both stages apply the same quality standards for distractors, answer leakage, duplicates, and source overlap. An option-only probe masks the state and query; instances with unresolved shortcuts are excluded. Appendix B details the review procedure and selection rules.
blocks.zh: 校验与选取. 我们利用来源证据、可执行检查和适合每个施工路线的模型审查来核实答案。 在进行五种模式多数筛选之后,对边缘案件进行独立的人权专家审查。 两个阶段对分流器、答漏、重复和源重叠适用相同的质量标准。 仅限选项的探测器掩盖状态和查询;未解决快捷键的情况不在此列 。 附 录 B详细介绍了审查程序和甄选规则。

blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate 28 System-1 decision models and use Random as a heuristic reference. These models return option probabilities directly through a decision-scoring head or a single decoding step, without generated reasoning or adaptive thinking. They include hosted APIs and locally deployed checkpoints. Each model uses its supported context window and option limit, preserving the capabilities available in its released checkpoint or API. Appendix C.1 details model selection, deployment settings, and the Random reference.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评价了28个System-1决策模型,并使用Random作为热度参考。 这些模型通过一个决策评分头或单一解码步骤直接返回选项概率,而不产生推理或适应性思维. 其中包括收容的科特迪瓦警察部队和当地部署的检查站。 每个模型都使用其支持的上下文窗口和选项限制,保留其释放的检查站或API中的现有能力. 附录C.1详细介绍了模型选择,部署设置,以及Random参考.

blocks.en:
Protocol and Metrics. The evaluator preserves the query and all option names and criteria, deterministically removing the middle of the state when the context budget is exceeded. Independent option sets exceeding a model’s option cap are divided into groups that fit the cap. Each request scores all options in a group together. From each group, the highest-probability option advances for single-select, and up to | G | |G| highest-probability options advance for multi-select. This reduction repeats until the retained options fit one final request. Reference cardinality and gold identities are hidden from the model. Option-dependent and distributional tasks keep the entire option set without splitting; inputs exceeding the model’s option cap count as capacity failures. Grouped outputs contribute to hard selection metrics; full-distribution metrics use native responses.
We use the metrics defined in Section 3.1 . Hard accuracies retain every question in the corresponding track, including failed requests. SB-F, Soft Brier, and Score nMAE use native predictions.
Appendix C.2 specifies token budgets, grouping, and failure accounting.

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 总体业绩

blocks.en: Similar single-select accuracy can accompany very different probability quality. In Table 2 , WeMM-JEV and KnowLine differ by less than one percentage point in single-select accuracy. Yet KnowLine has nearly half the Soft Brier error and less than one-third the Score nMAE of WeMM-JEV. A model that chooses the right option frequently can therefore still be a poor fit for applications that use its probabilities or expected scores.
blocks.zh: 类似的单选精度可以伴随非常不同的概率质量. 在表2中,WEMM-JEV和KnowLine在单选精度上的差异小于一个百分点. 然而,KnowLine有近一半的软布赖尔出错,不到WemM-JEV的分数nMAE的三分之一. 因此,经常选择正确选择的模型仍可能不适合使用其概率或预期分数的应用程序。

blocks.en: Complete multi-select identification and probability support remain weak. The highest multi-select accuracy in Table 2 is only 36.81%, and every model has an SB-F below 0.20. This means that current models often fail to recover the complete set of valid options and to assign probability appropriately across them. Thus, improving multi-select decisions requires progress not only in finding all correct options, but also in representing their relative support reliably.
blocks.zh: 完整的多选择识别和概率支持仍然薄弱。 表2中最高的多选取精度只有36.81%,每个模型的SB-F都低于0.20. 这意味着,目前的模型往往无法收回一整套有效的选项,并适当划分它们之间的概率。 因此,要改进多选择的决定,不仅需要在找到所有正确的选择方面取得进展,而且要在可靠地反映它们的相对支持方面取得进展。

blocks.en: Expected-score accuracy and distribution fidelity favor different models. Jev achieves the lowest Soft Brier, while KnowLine achieves the lowest Score nMAE. GPT-6 Luna Decisions also has a lower Score nMAE than Microsoft Decision-1 despite a higher Soft Brier. This difference arises because the expected score compresses an entire probability distribution into a single value, allowing probability errors at different score levels to cancel out. Therefore, reporting both metrics shows whether a model predicts a useful final score and whether the probabilities behind that score are themselves accurate.
blocks.zh: 预想得分的准确度和分布的忠诚度有利于不同的模型. Jev实现最低的Soft Brier,而KnowLine实现最低分数nMAE. GPT-6"Luna Sciences"也拥有比微软"决定一"更低的分数nMAE,尽管有更高的Soft Brier. 这种差异之所以产生,是因为预期分数将整个概率分布压缩成一个单一值,使得不同分数级的概率错误可以被取消. 因此,报告两个衡量标准都表明一个模型是否预测了有用的最终分数,以及该分数背后的概率本身是否准确.

blocks.en: Models struggle when several conditions must hold at once. WeMM-JEV leads Deductive Reasoning in Table 3 , yet scores below 60% on Option Logic, Constraint Planning, and Workflow Decision. KnowLine shows the same contrast, with 86.0% on Deductive Reasoning but 54.6% on Option Logic and 48.5% on Constraint Planning. In these tasks, an option may look correct on its own but conflict with another option, a rule, or an earlier action. MMDM separates these requirements from deduction, exposing a weakness in joint consistency that the broad knowledge-and-reasoning score of JEVal does not isolate.
blocks.zh: 模特儿在几个条件必须同时存在的时候挣扎 在表3中, WeMM-JEV 引领降级原因, 然而在选择逻辑、约束性规划和工作流程决定中得分低于60%。 KnowLine也有同样的对比,其中86.0%为减法推理,54.6%为选择逻辑,48.5%为约束规划。 在这些任务中,一个选项本身看起来可能是正确的,但与另一个选项、规则或更早的行动相冲突。 MMDM将这些要求与扣除区分开来,暴露出JEVal的广泛知识和推理分数不相隔离的共同一致性弱点.

blocks.en: Similar overall accuracy can hide very different strengths across tasks. Table 3 shows that WeMM-JEV performs better on world knowledge and emotion recognition, while KnowLine is stronger on workflow decisions and policy handling. Models with lower overall scores can still lead particular categories. Quyet achieves the highest accuracy on Evidence Validation, while Mapika leads Emotion Recognition. These differences show why category-level results matter when selecting a model for a specific workload, since a higher overall score does not guarantee better performance on the capabilities that workload actually requires.
blocks.zh: 类似的整体准确性可以隐藏不同任务之间的非常不同的长处. 表3显示,WEMM-JEV在世界知识和情感识别方面表现更好,而KnowLine在工作流程决定和政策处理方面表现更强. 总体分数较低的模型仍然可以领导特定类别. Quyet在"证据验证"上实现了最高的准确度,而Mapika则领导"情感识别". 这些差异表明,为什么在为具体工作量选择模型时,类别一级的成果很重要,因为总体得分较高并不能保证工作量实际需要的能力得到更好的表现。

blocks.en: Strong routing performance does not guarantee strong agent decision making. GPT-6 Luna Decisions outperforms Jev and Microsoft Decision-1 on Intent Routing, but performs worse on Tool and Skill Selection, Agent State Tracking, and Workflow Decision. The largest gap appears in Workflow Decision, which requires the model to account for prerequisites and action order. This shows that routing correctly does not necessarily mean the model can also choose the right action from the current agent state or coordinate a multi-step workflow.
blocks.zh: 强有力的路由性能并不能保证强有力的代理决策. GPT-6 Luna Decisions performs Jev和微软关于特意跑步的决定1,但在工具和技能选择、代理状态跟踪和工作流程决定方面表现更差. 最大的差距出现在 " 工作流动决定 " 中,该决定要求该模式考虑到先决条件和行动秩序。 这表明正确路由并不一定意味着模型也可以从当前代理状态中选择正确的动作或协调多步工作流程.

blocks.en: 4.4 Confidence Calibration
blocks.zh: 4.4 信任校正

blocks.en: Overconfidence appears at different operating ranges. Figure 3 compares five representative models using reliability curves and expected calibration error (ECE), where lower is better. Intern-Decision is overconfident in the middle of its range. OpenJev is closer to the diagonal there, but its highest-confidence bin averages about 0.97 confidence and 0.87 accuracy. Thus, this difference matters in deployment because the same confidence threshold may be reliable for one model but overly aggressive for another one when making decision.
blocks.zh: 过度自信出现在不同的操作范围. 图3比较了使用可靠性曲线和预期校正误差(ECE)的5个代表性模型,后者较低。 实习决定在其范围中间过于自信. OpenJev更接近于那里的对角,但其最高的自信本平均约为0.97置信度和0.87准确度. 因此,这种差异在部署上很重要,因为同一个信任门槛对一种模式来说可能是可靠的,但在作出决定时对另一种模式来说是过于激进的。

blocks.en: Higher selection accuracy does not ensure better calibration. OpenJev has higher single-select accuracy than Intern-Decision in Table 2 , yet Figure 3 gives it a larger ECE. Perplexity and Jev achieve the lowest ECE among the five representatives, while Microsoft Decision-1 has the largest error and remains below the diagonal through much of the moderate-to-high confidence range. The curves and aggregate errors together show why model selection should account for both how often a model is correct and how reliably its confidence reflects that correctness.
blocks.zh: 选择精度的提高不能确保更好的校正。 OpenJev的单选精度高于表2中的实习决定,而图3则赋予它更大的ECE. 迷惑和Jev在5个代表中实现了最低的欧洲经委会,而微软第1个决定的误差最大,通过中高信任范围的大部分仍然低于对角. 曲线和总误差一起表明,为什么模型选择应既说明模型的正确度有多高,又说明模型的信心如何可靠地反映了这种正确性。

blocks.en: 4.5 Context and Option-Space Scaling
blocks.zh: 4.5 背景和可选空间放大

blocks.en: Model rankings change between long inputs and large option sets. The two panels of Figure 4 reveal different scaling profiles. OpenJev outperforms Intern-Decision in every option-count bin, but falls below it once complete inputs exceed 8K tokens. At 8K–16K tokens, their accuracies are 15.5% and 34.5%, respectively; on 129–1,024 options, they are 26.0% and 8.3%. This reversal distinguishes performance on long-input workloads from performance on large-option workloads. MMDM measures both axes because success on one does not predict the model ordering on the other.
blocks.zh: 模型排名在长输入和大选项集之间变化. 图4的两个面板揭示了不同的缩放配置. OpenJev 优于成绩 在每个选项计数箱中进行实习决定,但一旦完成输入超过8K个令牌,则会低于它. 在8K-16K令牌上,它们的速率分别为15.5%和34.5%;在129-1,024个选项上,它们分别为26.0%和8.3%。 这一逆转将长期投入工作量的业绩与大可选择工作量的业绩区分开来。 MMDM 测量两个轴,因为一个成功不会预测模型对另一个的顺序.

blocks.en: Large catalogs expose differences hidden by compact choices. In Figure 4 , Jev and Microsoft Decision-1 differ by about seven percentage points on 2–4 options, but by more than 37 points on 129–1,024 options. Perplexity retains the highest accuracy in the largest option bin, although its advantage over Jev is much smaller there than on 9–16 options. Across the released workloads and the protocol in Section 4.1 , the curves reveal both severe losses and changing relative advantages as the option space grows. A single aggregate accuracy would conceal these differences in the scale of decisions each model can handle.
blocks.zh: 大型目录暴露出紧凑选择所隐藏的差异. 在图4中,Jev和微软决定1在2–4选项上相差约7个百分点,但在129–1,024选项上相差超过37分. 复杂度在最大的选项箱中保留了最高的准确度,尽管它相对于Jev的优势远小于9–16选项. 纵观第4.1节中已释放的工作量和协议,曲线显示,随着选项空间的扩大,损失严重,相对优势也在不断变化。 单一的汇总准确性将掩盖每个模型能够处理的决定规模上的这些差异。

blocks.en: 4.6 Case Studies
blocks.zh: 4.6 案例研究

blocks.en: Models can accept a workflow or report that conflicts with other evidence. In Figure 5 (a), Perplexity V1.2 selects a workflow that approves a document before editing it. Publication requires approval of the final revision, so those later edits invalidate the certificate. Jev and Microsoft Decision-1 select a valid ordering. In Figure 5 (b), Hazel’s report is false under the unique consistent interpretation, yet all three models rank it above at least one true report. The two cases expose errors in checking an option against history or other options, even when the relevant conditions are explicit.
blocks.zh: 模型可以接受与其他证据相冲突的工作流程或报告. 在图5 (a)中,Perflexity V1.2在编辑文件前选择一个批准文件的工作流程. 出版需要批准最终修订,因此后期编辑者会将证书作废. Jev和微软决定1选择有效的订单. 在图5(b)中,Hazel的报告在独特的一致解释下是虚假的,然而所有三种模型都将其排列在至少一个真实报告之上. 这两个案例暴露了对照历史或其他选项检查某一选项时的错误,即使相关条件明确。

blocks.en: Models struggle to translate a simple record-level defect into the correct score distribution. In Figure 5 (c), eight of nine records satisfy every rubric criterion, while one record lacks a review stamp. A three-record sample receives the lower score only when it contains that record, which happens with probability one-third. However, Perplexity V1.2 and Jev assign more probability to the lower score, while Microsoft Decision-1 predicts the correct most likely score but still assigns the probabilities incorrectly. This example shows that even a simple scoring rule can lead to errors in both the predicted score and its probability distribution.
blocks.zh: 模型挣扎着将一个简单的记录级缺陷转化为正确的分数分配. 在图5(c)中,9个记录中有8个符合每个标题标准,而1个记录缺少审查印章。 一个有3个记录的样本只有在包含该记录时才会得到较低的分数,这在概率为三分之一的情况下发生. 然而,Perplexity V1.2和Jev为下等分数分配了更多的概率,而Microsoft Decretion-1则预测了最有可能的正确分数,但仍然错误地分配出概率. 这个例子表明,即使是简单的打分规则,也会导致预测分数及其概率分布的错误.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced MMDM, a benchmark of 5,448 questions across 16 task categories for evaluating text-based System-1 Decision Models. With option sets ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs reaching approximately 64K tokens, MMDM tests decisions across both familiar requests and complex contexts. Its single-select, multi-select, and soft-label tasks assess whether models choose correctly, identify all valid options, and assign useful probabilities and scores.
Our evaluation of 28 decision models reveals clear gaps between these capabilities and exposes dimensions of decision quality that are not captured by previous benchmarks.
The strongest models vary across answer types and task categories. High single-select accuracy can accompany inaccurate probabilities, while deduction and routing strengths coexist with weaknesses in joint constraints and workflow decisions. Reliability curves and scaling profiles further distinguish confidence quality from accuracy and long-input performance from large-option performance. These findings direct progress toward checking interacting conditions, handling larger decision spaces, and producing probabilities that support reliable choices and scores. We release MMDM and its evaluation toolkit to make progress on these capabilities easy to measure and compare.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了MMDM, 该基准涉及16个任务类别中的5,448个问题,用于评价基于文本的System-1决策模型。 选项集从2个到1 024个不等,投入达到约64K个信使,MMDM在熟悉的请求和复杂的背景中测试决定。 它的单选,多选,和软标签任务评估模型是否正确选择,确定所有有效选项,并分配有用的概率和分数.
我们对28个决策模式的评价表明,这些能力之间存在明显差距,并暴露出以往基准没有反映的决策质量层面。
最强模型因答案类型和任务类别而异. 高单选精度可伴随不准确的概率,而扣减和路由优势与联合约束和工作流程决定中的弱点并存. 可靠性曲线和缩放剖面进一步区分了信心质量与准确性,长期投入性能与大可选性能. 这些调查结果在检查互动条件、处理更大的决策空间和产生支持可靠选择和评分的概率方面直接取得进展。 我们发布了MMDM及其评价工具包,以使这些能力的进展易于衡量和比较。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
MMDM has three main limitations. First, it focuses on text-based decisions defined by a fixed state, query, and option set. Extending MMDM to multimodal inputs and interactive trajectories would broaden its coverage of real-world decision settings.
Second, multi-select questions are concentrated in option logic, constraint planning, workflows, and tool or skill selection, while most soft targets come from rubric scoring. These settings provide clear labels and verifiable target distributions, but broader evaluation of subjective judgments will require references that better capture variation across human assessments.
Third, MMDM combines newly constructed tasks with source-preserving adaptations, recompositions, and rewrites. Although recompositions and rewrites introduce new decision requirements and contexts, prior exposure to the underlying public source material may still occur.
blocks.zh:
MMDM主要有三个限制. 首先,它侧重于由固定状态、查询和选项集定义的基于文本的决定。 将MMDM扩大到多式联运投入和互动轨道将扩大其对现实世界决策设置的涵盖范围。
第二,多选题集中在选项逻辑,约束性规划,工作流程,以及工具或技能选择,而大多数软目标则出自道标分. 这些设置提供了清晰的标签和可核查的目标分布,但对主观判断的更广义的评价需要参考,以更好地捕捉不同人类评估的差异.
第三,MMDM结合了新构建的任务与保留源的适应,再分解,并重写. 尽管重新组合和改写引入了新的决策要求和背景,但在接触基本公共来源材料之前仍可能发生。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: MMDM combines publicly available research data with newly constructed decision tasks. We cite the source datasets and document their contributions in Appendix B . Source materials remain subject to their original terms of use. The same appendix describes model-assisted construction, label verification, and targeted human review, including independent assessment and adjudication of disagreements. Our experiments evaluate model predictions from recorded or simulated inputs; they do not execute the tools or workflows described in the questions. We release the benchmark and evaluation toolkit, with source attribution, to support transparent and reproducible research.
blocks.zh: MMDM将公开的研究数据与新建的决策任务相结合. 我们引用源数据集,并将其贡献记录在附录B中。 原始材料仍须遵守最初的使用条件。 同一附录介绍了模型辅助建筑、标签核查和有针对性的人文审查,包括对分歧的独立评估和裁定。 我们的实验评价了来自记录或模拟输入的模型预测;它们不执行问题中描述的工具或工作流程. 我们发布了基准和评价工具包,并附有来源归属,以支持透明和可复制的研究。

blocks.en: Appendix A Input Coverage and Task Definitions
blocks.zh: 附录A 投入范围和任务定义

blocks.en:
Classification and Coverage. Table A1 defines the 16 capabilities and links each one to its corresponding example in Appendix F . A category identifies the capability a decision requires; the answer type specifies whether the target is one option, a complete valid set, or a distribution.
We measure input length using the full text seen by the model, including the state, query, option names, and option criteria. Each example is capped at 65,535 tokens. Among the 5,448 examples, 3,155 are shorter than 1K tokens, while 356 exceed 8K tokens, including 107 longer than 32K. The number of options ranges from 2 to 1,024.
At inference time, the actual token usage can be slightly higher because model providers add their own request formatting and reserved tokens.
blocks.zh:
分类和覆盖范围。 表A1界定了16种能力,并将每种能力与附录F中的相应例子联系起来。 一类识别一个决定所需要的能力;答案类型指定目标是一个选项,一个完整的有效集,还是一个分布.
我们使用模型所看到的全文测量输入长度,包括状态、查询、选项名称和选项标准。 每个例子的上限为65,535个令牌. 在5,448个例子中,有3,155个是比1K个令牌短的,而356个是超过8K个令牌,其中包括107个比32K长. 选项数量从2到1,024.
推论时,由于模型提供者会添加自己的请求格式和保留符号,因此实际的符号用法可以略高.

blocks.en: Figure A1: Released input-length and option-count distributions. Complete input includes state, query, option names, and criteria under the common Qwen3.5-4B tokenizer. The state-plus-query view separates document content from catalog size.
blocks.zh: 图A1:释放出的投入长度和选项计数分布. 完整的输入包括状态,查询,选项名称,以及常见的Quen3.5-4B 表示器下的标准. State-plus-query视图将文档内容与目录大小区分开来.

blocks.en: Table A1: Task definitions and direct links to worked examples with saved model responses in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 表A1:任务定义和与工作实例的直接联系,附录F中保存的模型答复。

blocks.en: Decision Interfaces. Jev exposes three interfaces for different kinds of requests ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . They specify what the model returns. The answer types in Section 3.1 specify what makes a prediction correct and how it is evaluated.
blocks.zh: 决定界面。 Jev为不同类型的请求披露了三个接口(TypeSafe AI,2026.). 他们指定了模型返回的内容. 第3.1节中的答案类型具体说明了是什么使预测是正确的以及如何评价预测。

blocks.en: Choice compares named options. A support request might ask whether a ticket belongs to billing, shipping, or returns, with each option’s criterion defining its responsibilities. The response contains the selected option and a probability for every option. In MMDM, this distribution supports evaluation against a single correct option, a set of equally valid options, or a soft reference, according to the task’s answer type.
blocks.zh: 选择比较命名选项 。 支持请求可能询问机票是否属于计费、发货或退票,每个选项的标准都规定了其责任。 回复中包含选定的选项和每个选项的概率. 在MMDM中,这种分布支持根据任务答案类型的一个单一正确选项,一组同样有效的选项,或软引用来进行评价.

blocks.en: Noul answers a yes/no query, such as whether a message requests a refund. It returns the probability of yes; values near one favor yes, values near zero favor no, and values near one-half express uncertainty between them. The remaining probability belongs to no, giving the two-option distribution used in evaluation. A definite reference answer is hard single-select, while a reference that quantifies uncertainty is soft-label.
blocks.zh: 诺尔回答一个是/否的查询,例如消息是否要求退款. 它返回是概率; 值接近一个偏好是, 值接近零偏好否, 值接近一半 表示它们之间的不确定性 。 剩余概率属于否,给出评价中使用的双选项分布. 一个确定的参考答案是硬的单选,而一个量化不确定性的参考是软标签.

blocks.en: Score evaluates an input against ordered, descriptive rubric levels. For report completeness, these might range from missing required evidence to meeting every requirement. The response contains a probability for each level and their probability-weighted numeric score. MMDM evaluates both the level distribution and the expected score. Therefore, Scoring questions belong to the hard single-select or soft-label track, depending on whether the reference identifies one level or a distribution.
blocks.zh: 分数根据命令的,描述性的标题级别评价一个输入. 就报告的完整性而言,从缺少所需证据到满足每项要求,可能不一而足。 答复中包含每个关卡的概率及其概率加权数分. MMDM既评价级别分布,又评价预期分数. 因此,分分分问题属于硬的单选或软标签轨道,取决于参考物是否识别出一个级别或分布.

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Sources and Construction
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据来源和构建

blocks.en: B.1 Source Collection and Adaptation
blocks.zh: B.1 来源收集和适应

blocks.en:
Table A2 lists every public source represented in the release, its contribution, and the decision task obtained from it. We collect labeled questions, supporting documents, response comparisons, code and database problems, agent trajectories, and tool or skill descriptions.
Table A4 describes the question families that we construct from explicit rules, state transitions, and outcome mechanisms. For source-grounded rewrites, the original answer and its supporting context serve as semantic anchors. We rewrite the state and query and rephrase or replace distractors, preserving the facts and relations needed to justify the answer. The semantic and option-quality checks in Appendix B.4 verify that the revised input supports the reference answer and that incorrect options remain plausible but invalid.
blocks.zh:
表A2列出了发布时所代表的所有公共来源、其贡献以及从中获得的决定任务。 我们收集有标签的问题、辅助文件、反应比较、代码和数据库问题、代理轨迹、工具或技能说明。
表A4说明了我们从明确的规则、国家过渡和结果机制中构建的问题家庭。 对于基于源的重写,原始的答案及其支持上下文作为语义锚. 我们重写状态和询问,并重写或替换分心者,保留为回答辩护所需的事实和关系. 附录B.4中的语义和选项质量检查证实,修改后的投入支持参考答案,不正确的选项仍然可信但无效。

blocks.en: Table A2: Public sources used in the final release. Counts refer to released MMDM questions; codes follow Table 3 . Catalog sources ground new requests.
blocks.zh: 表A2:最后发行中使用的公共来源。 计数是指发布的MMDM问题;代码遵从表3. 编目来源提出了新的请求。

blocks.en: Table A3: Public sources used in the final release (continued).
blocks.zh: 表A3:最后发行时使用的公开来源(续)。

blocks.en: Knowledge, Language, and Document. Adaptations preserve task-relevant evidence and label semantics within the state–query–options interface. Knowledge and reading tasks retain the premises needed to distinguish the answer; multi-hop questions preserve the documents and links joining the required evidence. Entailment and moderation tasks express the source labels as named options with explicit meanings. Emotion tasks preserve the source text and the relevant emotion inventory. Preference tasks retain the compared responses and the criterion governing the comparison. A preference between responses remains a selection label; numerical annotations are used according to their original meaning.
blocks.zh: 知识、语言和文件。 适应在状态-query-options接口内保存了与任务相关的证据和标签语义. 知识和阅读任务保留了区分答案所需的前提;多跳问题保存文件和链接,并加入所需证据。 调和和节制任务将源标签表达为具有明确含义的命名选项. 情感任务保存出源文本和相关情感目录. 优先任务保留比较答复和比较标准。 答复之间的偏好仍然是选择标签;数字说明按其原始含义使用。

blocks.en: Code and Database. Program tasks preserve executable code and its input or specification. Database tasks provide the relevant schema and database conditions. In the BIRD adaptation ( Li et al., 2023 ) , we derive a decision query from the target SQL semantics and execute every SQL option against the source database. Validation checks the required operation, the resulting records, and whether distinct options produce distinguishable outputs. An option-only similarity probe checks whether a response can be selected by superficial resemblance among SQL statements without using the query, which rules out some naive samples.
blocks.zh: 代码与数据库. 程序任务保存可执行代码及其输入或规格. 数据库任务提供了相关的计划和数据库条件. 在BIRD改编(Li等,2023年)中,我们从目标SQL语义中得出一个决定查询,并针对源数据库执行每个SQL选项. 验证检查所需操作,产生的记录,以及不同的选项是否产生可区分的产出. 一个只选项的相似性探测器检查一个响应是否可以在SQL语句中通过表面相似来选择,而不使用查询,这就排除了一些天真的样本.

blocks.en: Retrieval and Freshness. Adaptive-RAG ( Jeong et al., 2024 ) supplies retrieval-strategy decisions, while RetrievalQA ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) supplies cases requiring a judgment about external retrieval. FreshQA ( Vu et al., 2024 ) supplies stable, time-sensitive, and false-premise questions. Its adaptation provides an explicit evidence date and decision date, and asks whether the available evidence suffices, should be refreshed, or contains a premise that should be rejected. The target is tied to the dated evidence presented in the state.
blocks.zh: 取取与取取出. 适应-RAG(Jeong等人,2024年)提供检索-战略决定,同时检索 QA (Zhang等,2024年) 提供需要判断外部检索的案件. FreshQA (Vu等, 2024) 提供稳定,有时间敏感性,以及假假问题. 其修改提供了明确的证据日期和决定日期,并询问现有证据是否足够,是否应予更新,或包含一个应予驳回的前提。 目标与该州提供的日期相挂钩。

blocks.en: Agent Histories and Skill Catalogs. At a decision point t t , the state is the observed interaction prefix h ≤ t h_{\leq t} , and the query asks which tool or skill is appropriate next. The prefix ends before the target action. Options contain tool names and contracts or skill names and descriptions. The release includes 239 such decisions from ComplexFuncBench ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) and ToolTalk ( Farn and Shin, 2023 ) , comprising 163 tool selections and 76 skill selections. Two separate DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) calls review the history and every option with labels hidden and option order changed. Acceptance requires agreement on present applicability and the complete valid set.
blocks.zh: 历史和技能目录特工 在决定点 t t 时,状态是观察到的交互前缀 h ≤ t h_{\leq t } ,而查询则询问下一个是合适的工具或技能. 前缀在目标动作前结束. 选项包含工具名和合同或技能名和说明。 该版包括ComplexFunc Bench(Zhong等,2025年)和Toltalk(Farn和Shin,2023年)的239个此类决定,包括163个工具选择和76个技能选择. 两个独立的DeepSeek-V4-Pro(DeepSeek-AI,2026)呼唤审查历史和每个选项,标签被隐藏,选项顺序被更改. 接受要求就目前的适用性和整套有效办法达成协议。

blocks.en: Catalog-based questions use task and environment descriptions from SkillsBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) , retrieval annotations from ToolRet ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , and skill descriptions from Graph of Skills ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Generated requests introduce concrete goals and prerequisites grounded in these descriptions. An additional 31 questions are built from a collected directory of 10,798 skills with provenance preserved. For each question, we review every option for functional overlap and applicability to the current request; all valid options are included in the multi-select target. Original retrieval positives and packaged skills serve as reference candidates, while the expanded option set is independently reviewed to determine the labels.
blocks.zh: 基于目录的问题使用来自Swilling Bench(Li等,2026年)的任务和环境描述,取自Tollect(Shi等,2025年)的检索说明,取自"技能图"(Liu等,2026年). 所产生的请求在这些描述的基础上提出了具体的目标和先决条件。 另有31个问题是根据10 798个保存出处技能的收集目录编写的。 对于每个问题,我们审查每个功能重叠的选项以及对当前请求的适用性;所有有效的选项都包含在多选择的目标中. 原始检索阳性和打包技能成为参考候选人,而扩展的选项集则独立审查以确定标签.

blocks.en: B.2 Original Task Construction
blocks.zh: B.2 最初的任务构建

blocks.en: We construct new decision instances by specifying a mechanism, computing its reference answer, and rendering its states and conditions as natural language. The mechanism determines which details affect the decision. Distractors implement plausible mistakes, including an omitted prerequisite, an expired authorization, a stale artifact, a confused entity, or a missed exception. The final families and their validation procedures appear in Table A4 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过指定一个机制,计算其参考答案,并将其状态和条件作为自然语言来构建新的决策实例。 该机制决定哪些细节影响决定。 分散注意力者执行一些可能的错误,包括遗漏的前提条件、过期的授权、陈旧的文物、混乱的实体或遗漏的例外。 最终家庭及其鉴定程序见表A4。

blocks.en:
Interdependent Options and Constrained Plans. Logic tasks define propositions whose truth values depend on other propositions. We enumerate satisfying assignments and check them with an independent truth-table implementation. Single-select questions ask for the unique complete interpretation; multi-select questions ask for all true propositions under that interpretation. Global interpretation rules are stated in the state, and interdependent statements appear in option.criteria . We check entity references, quantifier scope, and natural-language statements against the formal propositions.
Planning tasks evaluate complete proposed assignments against eligibility, scheduling, resource, and precedence constraints; all feasible plans remain valid options.
blocks.zh:
独立选项和限制计划。 逻辑任务定义了其真实值取决于其他命题的命题. 我们列举了令人满意的任务,并以独立的真相表加以核查。 单选问题要求独特的完整解释;多选问题要求根据这种解释提出所有真正的建议。 全球解释规则在州内阐明,相互依存的声明出现在备选方案中。 标准。 我们对照正式的主张,检查实体的参考文献、限定范围以及自然语言的说明。
规划任务根据资格、日程安排、资源和优先性等因素评价全部拟议任务;所有可行的计划仍然是有效的选择。

blocks.en: State Transitions and Workflows. State tasks reconstruct the current situation from events and tool receipts. Their mechanisms track goal scope, artifact versions, committed or rolled-back updates, evidence readiness, and execution failures. Transactional histories are checked both by folding the event sequence and by independent SQLite replay. Workflow tasks compare complete action sequences under prerequisites and revision-sensitive certificates. A simulator tracks state and content versions, while a separate checker verifies action positions and required orderings. Workflow option sets contain at most 128 sequences.
blocks.zh: 国家转型与工作流程. 国家的任务从事件和接收工具中重建目前的局势。 它们的机制跟踪目标范围、文物版本、承诺更新或回滚更新、证据准备情况和执行失败。 通过折叠事件序列和通过独立的 SQLite 重放来检查交易历史 。 工作流程任务在先决条件和修正敏感证书下比较完整的动作序列. 一个模拟器跟踪状态和内容版本,而一个单独的检查器验证动作位置并需要命令. 工作流程选项集最多包含128个序列.

blocks.en: Scenario and Rule Composition. Additional original tasks combine policy conditions, evidence, tools, practical planning, and scoring in concrete scenarios. Compositional rule programs introduce thresholds, exceptions, authority levels, document versions, and joins between pieces of evidence. Natural-language renderings preserve the facts and rules that determine the computed answer. For tasks with finite uncertain outcomes, the state supplies the underlying weights, transition probabilities, or sampling process used to derive the reference distribution.
blocks.zh: 设想和规则组成。 其他原始任务结合政策条件,证据,工具,实际规划,在具体情景中评分. 组成规则程序引入了阈值,例外,权威级别,文件版本,并在证据块之间相接. 自然语言渲染保留了决定计算答案的事实和规则. 对于结果不确定的有限任务,国家提供用来得出参考分布的基础权重、过渡概率或取样过程。

blocks.zh: B.3 回答编码和标签衍生

blocks.en: B.4 Cleaning, Correction, and Verification
blocks.zh: B.4 清洁、矫正和核查

blocks.en: We initially collected 683,237 instances from public sources, retaining 669,135 after normalization and deduplication. We subsequently constructed 75,588 additional instances, producing a pool of 744,723 for selection.
blocks.zh: 我们最初从公共来源收集了683 237起案例,在正常化和分裂后保留了669 135起。 我们后来又建造了75 588个案例,产生了744 723个人才库供挑选。

blocks.en:
Representation and Semantic Checks. We check unique item and option identities, complete option references, valid score scales, normalized nonnegative labels, and agreement between answer types and references. Source-parent and request-overlap checks compare related instances with registered training, replay, and evaluation records.
Answers are checked against source evidence, execution, independent formal computation, or blind review. Repairs undergo the corresponding check again; unresolved failures are excluded.
blocks.zh:
代表与语义检查. 我们检查独有的项目和选项身份,完整选项引用,有效分数分数分数分数分数,规范非负标签,以及答案类型和引用之间达成一致. 来源和请求重叠检查将相关实例与注册培训、重播和评价记录进行比较。
答复根据来源证据、执行、独立的正式计算或盲目审查加以核对。 修理再次进行相应的检查;未解决的故障不包括在内。

blocks.en: Option Quality. We further check whether the options can be distinguished from the information available in the state and query, rather than from superficial cues. Distractors should reflect realistic failure modes, such as overlooking a prerequisite or choosing a tool with similar functionality but incompatible requirements. We also mask the state and query and ask whether the answer can still be guessed from option names or descriptions alone. Options with obvious shortcuts, copied answers, or weak distinctions are removed. For SQL tasks, we additionally check whether different queries are semantically equivalent and whether surface similarity reveals the answer.
blocks.zh: 选择质量。 我们进一步检查这些选项是否可以与状态和查询中的信息区分开来,而不是与表面提示区分开来. 干扰器应反映现实的故障模式,例如忽略一个先决条件或选择一个功能相似但要求不相容的工具。 我们还掩盖状态并询问是否仅从选项名称或描述中仍然可以猜测答案. 带有明显快捷键的选项,复制的答案,或者弱区分被删除. 对于 SQL 任务,我们额外检查不同的查询是否在表层等同,表面相似性是否揭示答案.

blocks.en: Multi-model Screening. Candidate instances are screened by DeepSeek ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) with high reasoning effort, Gemini-3.8-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , and GLM-5.2 ( Z.ai, 2026 ) . Each model independently judges whether an instance meets the representation, semantic, and option-quality standards above. Four or five accept votes support automatic inclusion; a 3–2 vote sends the instance to human review, and fewer than three accept votes exclude it. This stage accepted 4,715 instances automatically and referred 928 borderline cases for human review.
blocks.zh: 多模式筛选. 候选案例由DeepSeek(DeepSeek-AI,2026年),GPT-6-Astra(OpenAI,2026年b)进行筛选,进行高推理努力,双子座-3.8-Flash(Google DeepMind,2026年),Qune3.8-Max(Quen Team,2026b),和GLM-5.2(Z.ai,2026年)进行筛选. 每个模型独立地判断一个案例是否符合上述代表、语义和选择质量标准。 四到五票接受支持自动列入;一票一票一票一票二票让人审查,不到三票接受排除. 这一阶段自动受理了4 715起个案,并将928起分界线案件移交人审查。

blocks.en: Independent Human Review. Two reviewers independently assessed all 928 borderline cases under a common standard operating procedure (SOP). The SOP applies the representation, semantic, and option-quality standards above, using source evidence, verification traces, and option-only probe results from the earlier checks. Reviewers verify that the state and query support the reference answer, that all valid options are represented, and that distractors reflect plausible errors rather than superficial cues. Their initial decisions agreed on 97.3% of cases; a third reviewer adjudicated the remaining disagreements. Corrections underwent the corresponding semantic or executable checks before inclusion. Combining automatically accepted and human-reviewed instances produced the final 5,448 questions.
blocks.zh: 独立人文评论. 两名审查人员根据共同标准作业程序独立评估了所有928起分界线案件。 SOP运用上面的表示,语义,和选项质量标准,利用源证据,验证痕迹,以及早期检查得出的仅选项的探测结果. 审查者核实状态和查询支持参考答案,所有有效的选项都得到代表,分心者反映的是可能的错误而不是表面提示. 他们的初步决定就97.3%的案件达成了一致;第三名审查员裁定了其余的分歧。 更正在列入之前经过相应的语义检查或可执行检查。 将自动接受和经人审查的事例结合起来,产生了最后5 448个问题。

blocks.en: C.2 Protocol and Metrics

blocks.en:
Context and Option Handling. For context budget B B , service allowance H H , and output reserve R R , the adapter preserves the query, all options, and their criteria. It keeps approximately equal token spans from the start and end of the state and recounts the serialized request against B − H − R B-H-R . Truncation preserves Unicode boundaries and inserts an omission marker. Runs record the provider or proxy tokenizer. Fixed-field overflow and provider rejection count as failures; grouped calls share the prepared state.
All requests follow the protocol in Section 4.1 . A supported catalog is evaluated in one call. An independent catalog above the option cap is reduced recursively, with each call presenting all options in its group alongside the same prepared state. The highest-probability option in each group advances for hard single-select. For hard multi-select, the evaluator uses N = | G | N=|G| both as the evaluation cutoff and as the maximum number retained from each group; neither N N nor the reference option identities enter model requests. The metric evaluates complete-set ordering at this reference cardinality. Option-dependent and distributional tasks retain the complete option set without splitting. If that set exceeds a model’s option cap, the request is recorded as a capacity failure.

Table A7 compares the five representative models on shared questions. For each metric, we retain questions for which all five models produced valid, native predictions using the complete input. With the questions and input handling held fixed, Perplexity V1.2 leads both hard-answer metrics, while Jev has the lowest Soft Brier and Score nMAE. blocks.en: We further examine the probability distributions behind these multi-select results. Table A10 reports SB-F, separation, and balance on 284 questions shared by all 28 decision models, with results also broken down by category.

blocks.en:
Weak Separation. WeMM-JEV and Perplexity V1.2 have the highest SB-F (0.1905 and 0.1900, respectively), but excel on different tasks. WeMM-JEV is stronger on Option Logic and Constraint Planning, while Perplexity performs better on Workflow Decision and Tool and Skill Selection. We average each metric over questions for each model. The medians across models are 0.113 for separation and 0.862 for balance, while median correct-option coverage is only 37.8%. Models therefore often distribute probability evenly among correct options without separating them from incorrect ones.
Jev illustrates this pattern, with average balance of 0.915 and separation of 0.137. OpenJev has stronger separation but lower balance. Jev’s category results make the distinction clearer. Its SB-F falls from 0.465 on Tool and Skill Selection to 0.022 on Option Logic, where balance remains high (0.973) but separation is low (0.023). The main difficulty in these questions is distinguishing interdependent true statements from false ones.

blocks.en: State Reconstruction. We compare three types of state-tracking question, each with 16 options, using native predictions from all five representative models on complete inputs. Jev and Perplexity answer all 47 artifact-version questions correctly, identifying outputs with the required source version, validation, and approval. Their accuracies fall to 8.3% and 16.7% on 24 transactional-state questions, which require applying an ordered sequence of transactions under revision, lock, and capacity constraints. On 100 goal-scope questions, which ask which instructions apply given their owner, workspace, and revision, Jev reaches 26.0% and Perplexity 75.0%. Median input lengths are 2,836, 4,252, and 1,800 tokens, respectively.

blocks.en: D.6 Task-Conditioned Probability Diagnostics
blocks.zh: D.6 任务安排 概率诊断

blocks.en:
Confidence Across Tasks. We examine predictions with confidence at least 0.9 among the 3,537 shared questions in the reliability analysis. Jev is almost equally confident on retrieval strategy (mean 0.969 over 123 predictions) and contextual emotion (0.968 over 50), yet accuracy differs sharply, at 97.6% and 50.0%, respectively. OpenJev answers all 55 high-confidence SQL questions correctly, compared with 63.2% of its 38 high-confidence emotion questions. Thus, the same confidence threshold corresponds to different error rates across tasks.
To capture this variation, we compute ECE separately within each task category using the same ten confidence bins, then weight the results by question count. This prevents overconfidence in one task from cancelling underconfidence in another. ECE rises from 0.054 to 0.106 for Jev, from 0.085 to 0.110 for Intern-Decision, and from 0.092 to 0.116 for OpenJev. Jev illustrates the opposing errors, with confidence exceeding accuracy by 38.6% on Emotion Recognition but falling below it by 29.0% on Workflow Decision.

Expected Scores and Their Distributions. We examine 596 sampled-rubric questions using native predictions from all five models on complete inputs. For predictions with nMAE at most 0.05, equivalent to an error of at most 0.2 points on the 0–4 scale, we measure distribution error using total variation, TV ⁡ ( p , π ) = 1 2 ​ ∑ j | p j − π j | \operatorname{TV}(p,\pi)=\frac{1}{2}\sum_{j}|p_{j}-\pi_{j}| . This is the probability mass that must be reassigned to match the reference. Jev meets this nMAE threshold on 190 questions and Intern-Decision on 111. Their mean TV errors remain 0.323 and 0.306, respectively. Thus, a close estimate of the expected score can still misrepresent the probabilities of individual score levels.
Each question scores a random subset of records against four criteria. The expected total score depends on the four individual pass probabilities, while the full score distribution also depends on which criteria pass together. Using the exact pass probabilities, we construct an approximation that treats the criteria as independent. It preserves the expected score but produces mean Brier and TV errors of 0.0127 and 0.0690 across the 596 questions. This illustrates why accurate expected scores and accurate score distributions require different information.

As some of the wildling clans board Stannis’ ships to travel south, a massive force of wights, led by White Walkers and their Night King, attacks the village. Jon kills a White Walker with Longclaw, learning that weapons forged with Valyrian steel can destroy them completely. Jon and his group barely make it out alive, with only a fraction of the wildling forces. Jon then permits the wildling forces to pass through the Wall into the North. Shortly after returning to Castle Black in the season finale “Mother’s Mercy”, Jon is summoned to hear news of his missing uncle Benjen, but is instead stabbed to death by Thorne and his group of mutineers.
